summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Samuel Bocquillon photography website (French wedding photographer). Tested backend APIs (18 endpoints), SSR/SEO compliance, frontend UI/UX across desktop and mobile, navigation, forms, admin zone, and all required features from cahier des charges.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 403 instead of 401 when uploading without authentication
minor_issues.impact: None - both status codes are acceptable for unauthorized access. Review request specified '401/403' as acceptable.

minor_observations.issue: Some filter tab testids may not match expected naming (élopement, petit-comité)
minor_observations.impact: Filters are functional, just testid naming differs slightly

minor_observations.issue: Pricing card testids don't match expected pattern (home-pricing-card-essentiel/signature/prestige)
minor_observations.impact: Cards are visible and functional, just testid mismatch in test script
